A 0-to-10 track that measures how much the Second Inquisition knows. It rises with Masquerade breaches, with public violence, with contact between Helen and FIRSTLIGHT, and with the fragments Halloway leaks every night the plot moves forward without a response. It drops when the coterie cleans up traces, recovers copies of the File, or neutralizes the mole.

Starts at 2 · scale 0–10 · handout: @UUID[JournalEntry.b13NIR35K7HpthZv]{FIRSTLIGHT's Thermometer}

Players can see it; better if they don't see the exact number (@UUID[JournalEntry.b13NIR35K7HpthZv]{AYU-03}, doc 15). It helps for them to know it exists (doc 03).

How to keep it from rising

  • Taking Helen out by the fire escape avoids the 3B camera; opening the camera carefully and disconnecting it (Dexterity + Larceny, Difficulty 3) doesn't raise it; Obfuscate (Cloak of Shadows) keeps it from recording whoever uses it, but not the others · @UUID[JournalEntry.w9xeQJg6psfiMjFU.JournalEntryPage.yyXMKcpDOIhGuZIB]{A0-E01 · The Call from SAFE} doc 10
  • Convincing the officers at Terminal 46 that it's “a funeral home dumping ashes”: the case is closed, @UUID[JournalEntry.Gfcnqy3u5K3xDilP]{DOC-09} doesn't exist, and the Thermometer doesn't rise on Night 3 · @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.DtetdHiBnOLQaM6Y]{A1-E02 · Ash at Pier 46} · Night 3 doc 10
  • Dealing with Teo before Night 4: buying him off, convincing him, or wiping his memory (the last one, 1 Stain to anyone without a good reason) · @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.DtetdHiBnOLQaM6Y]{A1-E02 · Ash at Pier 46} · Night 4 doc 10
  • Cleaning up the scene at Sal's warehouse: staging it as a robbery (Intelligence + Subterfuge, Difficulty 3) or calling Montgomery · @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.j4TnqYOwVuSCeQ0z]{A2-E02 · “Locate. Assess. Execute.”} doc 11
  • Disabling ANOMALY from outside (Intelligence + Technology, Difficulty 4; Ezra +2 dice if he discovered the firmware is his; automatic with @UUID[JournalEntry.x7rVnQfKbb3HdbG5.JournalEntryPage.qA75WygzgVjOeJvT]{LOR-03} at level 4) · @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.EjJ0vfVBCjTTb0QV]{A3-E02 · The Data Center} doc 12
  • Fooling ANOMALY: @UUID[JournalEntry.x7rVnQfKbb3HdbG5.JournalEntryPage.qA75WygzgVjOeJvT]{LOR-03} at level 4, prepared thermal clothing (Intelligence + Technology, Difficulty 4, per scene), or disabling the module locally (Intelligence + Technology, Difficulty 4). Obfuscate doesn't fool it doc 14
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.x7rVnQfKbb3HdbG5.JournalEntryPage.qA75WygzgVjOeJvT]{LOR-03} level 3 “Erase”: once per story, when the Thermometer would rise because of a camera, it doesn't · @UUID[JournalEntry.x7rVnQfKbb3HdbG5.JournalEntryPage.qA75WygzgVjOeJvT]{LOR-03 · The City's Eyes} doc 08
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.AnZpyM4onyACPwiC.JournalEntryPage.UFOfuIElB3CH4nQE]{GAN-08}: burying the viral video within 48 hours (Intelligence + Technology, Difficulty 5): the Thermometer doesn't rise · @UUID[JournalEntry.AnZpyM4onyACPwiC.JournalEntryPage.UFOfuIElB3CH4nQE]{GAN-08 · The Viral Video} doc 09

The city moves even if the coterie doesn't act. Each night that passes, the event on the table happens. If the coterie steps in first, the event changes or disappears. The date is that of each night's small hours.

Each night's date is that of its small hours (doc 10: “Date (early hours of)”). Docs 11 to 13 use that same day for the evening hours of the night (Denny's, Monday the 16th at 11:00 p.m.; Council, Thursday the 19th at 10:30 p.m.). When a time carries its own “dia” field, that's the one the doc gives.
